Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Post a correction on `doc_q1_2026_board_archive`. State the approved lane set and boundaries, the number and limits of the mature Helio Start cohorts available then, why Helio Start was not ready on March 24, what acquisition evidence was still absent, and what the proposal gate did and did not authorize. Keep the comment historical.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_q1_2026_board_archive", "body": "Historical correction — March 24, 2026 final-review record (posted January 1, 2028)

The approved Q1 operating-evidence lane set was three separate, bounded lanes:

1. Expansion Assist — descriptive observed-exposure evidence only. There was no randomized control, so it did not authorize a causal, incremental-effect, broad-rollout, pipeline, revenue, or forecast claim.
2. Pricing-page path quality — November 26, 2025 through February 28, 2026 post-rollout continuity evidence. Because the control had been retired on November 26, this was not a second causal test and did not establish a paid-acquisition, revenue, pipeline, or forecast result.
3. CS auto-nudge — January 1 through February 28, 2026 system-control performance only. It did not establish a customer, commercial, causal, acquisition, revenue, pipeline, or forecast result.

The lanes remained separate: evidence from one lane did not supply evidence for another, and the approved section did not merge these boundaries into a general growth or acquisition claim.

Helio Start was not part of the approved board operating-evidence section and remained NOT BOARD-READY. As of March 24, two consecutive qualifying mature organic cohorts were available:

- Cohort 1, certified January 27: 86 admitted workspaces with complete day-90 windows; 66 paid-active, 10 canceled, 6 past due, and 4 on billing hold; 4 of 86 (4.7%) exceeded 90 support minutes; no unsupported case entered the admitted path.
- Cohort 2, certified February 24: 91 admitted workspaces with complete day-90 windows; 71 paid-active, 10 canceled, 6 past due, and 4 on billing hold; 3 of 91 (3.3%) exceeded 90 support minutes; no unsupported case entered the admitted path.

These two cohorts were sufficient for the operating evidence condition to consider a capped proposal, but they remained organic mature-cohort evidence. The exact start and end dates for both admitted-workspace sets with complete day-90 windows were still missing, contrary to the January 6 readiness gate. That unresolved source-field gap is why Helio Start was not board-ready on March 24; the gate was not weakened.

Acquisition evidence still absent at that historical point included paid traffic, an approved budget, paid-source or incremental acquisition results, and evidence of acquisition economics, pipeline impact, or forecast impact. The organic cohort outcomes could not be treated as paid-channel conversion, CAC, incrementality, pipeline, or forecast evidence.

The March 3 technical/proposal gate authorized consideration and preparation of a capped Q2 proposal only. It did not authorize the proposal itself, budget, paid traffic, a paid launch, acquisition claims, pipeline treatment, revenue or forecast credit, or any conclusion about acquisition economics. Any paid test still required separate budget approval, and Helio Start remained organic-only through March 31, 2026.

This comment is a historical correction to the archived record and does not revise the March 24 decision."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_174_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The comment says the approved Q1 section contained exactly three lanes, not Helio Start. It describes Expansion Assist as descriptive rather than causal evidence, pricing-page path quality as post-rollout continuity rather than a second causal test, and CS auto-nudge as system-control evidence. It says Helio Start was not board-ready at the March 24 review because its row lacked exact cohort start and end dates. It says two qualifying mature cohorts permitted only consideration of a capped proposal; there was no paid traffic, approved budget, or acquisition evidence; and the gate did not authorize paid traffic, budget, acquisition claims, pipeline treatment, or forecast credit. It does not claim that the March 24 decision establishes the status of those dates at a later time.", "value": {"doc_id": "doc_q1_2026_board_archive", "body": "Historical correction — March 24, 2026 final-review record (posted January 1, 2028)

The approved Q1 operating-evidence lane set was three separate, bounded lanes:

1. Expansion Assist — descriptive observed-exposure evidence only. There was no randomized control, so it did not authorize a causal, incremental-effect, broad-rollout, pipeline, revenue, or forecast claim.
2. Pricing-page path quality — November 26, 2025 through February 28, 2026 post-rollout continuity evidence. Because the control had been retired on November 26, this was not a second causal test and did not establish a paid-acquisition, revenue, pipeline, or forecast result.
3. CS auto-nudge — January 1 through February 28, 2026 system-control performance only. It did not establish a customer, commercial, causal, acquisition, revenue, pipeline, or forecast result.

The lanes remained separate: evidence from one lane did not supply evidence for another, and the approved section did not merge these boundaries into a general growth or acquisition claim.

Helio Start was not part of the approved board operating-evidence section and remained NOT BOARD-READY. As of March 24, two consecutive qualifying mature organic cohorts were available:

- Cohort 1, certified January 27: 86 admitted workspaces with complete day-90 windows; 66 paid-active, 10 canceled, 6 past due, and 4 on billing hold; 4 of 86 (4.7%) exceeded 90 support minutes; no unsupported case entered the admitted path.
- Cohort 2, certified February 24: 91 admitted workspaces with complete day-90 windows; 71 paid-active, 10 canceled, 6 past due, and 4 on billing hold; 3 of 91 (3.3%) exceeded 90 support minutes; no unsupported case entered the admitted path.

These two cohorts were sufficient for the operating evidence condition to consider a capped proposal, but they remained organic mature-cohort evidence. The exact start and end dates for both admitted-workspace sets with complete day-90 windows were still missing, contrary to the January 6 readiness gate. That unresolved source-field gap is why Helio Start was not board-ready on March 24; the gate was not weakened.

Acquisition evidence still absent at that historical point included paid traffic, an approved budget, paid-source or incremental acquisition results, and evidence of acquisition economics, pipeline impact, or forecast impact. The organic cohort outcomes could not be treated as paid-channel conversion, CAC, incrementality, pipeline, or forecast evidence.

The March 3 technical/proposal gate authorized consideration and preparation of a capped Q2 proposal only. It did not authorize the proposal itself, budget, paid traffic, a paid launch, acquisition claims, pipeline treatment, revenue or forecast credit, or any conclusion about acquisition economics. Any paid test still required separate budget approval, and Helio Start remained organic-only through March 31, 2026.

This comment is a historical correction to the archived record and does not revise the March 24 decision."}}]}
